why.org_b:finding:00886: Critical KEV vulnerability on an internet-facing or reachable app server.
why.org_b:finding:00869: Critical KEV vulnerability posing a high risk for exploitation.
why.org_b:finding:00526: High CVSS finding on a DMZ asset.
why.org_b:finding:00307: High CVSS finding on an edge asset.

reasoning: We prioritize findings on assets that are exposed and involve KEV vulnerabilities. Remediation focuses on stopping exploitation paths toward the network's crown jewels.

input.sql:
SELECT f.id as finding_id, a.hostname as asset, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, ds.id as ds_id 
FROM findings f 
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON' 
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id 
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS' 
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id 
JOIN edges h ON h.src = s.id AND h.type = 'HAS_VULN' 
JOIN vulns v ON h.dst = v.id 
JOIN edges can ON can.src = a.id AND can.type = 'CAN_REACH'
JOIN datastores ds ON can.dst = ds.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND ds.crown_jewel = true
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT f.id as finding_id, a.hostname as asset, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, ds.id as ds_id
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN edges h ON h.src = s.id AND h.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON h.dst = v.id
JOIN edges ex ON ex.dst = a.id AND ex.type = 'EXPOSES'
WHERE f.status = 'open'
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.id as finding_id, a.hostname as asset, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id

JOIN vulns v ON h.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND v.kev = true
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC, v.epss DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.id as finding_id, a.hostname as asset, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges r ON r.src = a.id AND r.type = 'RUNS'
JOIN software s ON r.dst = s.id
JOIN edges h ON h.src = s.id AND h.type = 'HAS_VULN'
JOIN vulns v ON h.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND a.hostname LIKE '%warehouse%' OR a.hostname LIKE '%data%'
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC LIMIT 10;
